## Appointment confirmations
**Portfolio demonstration. Fictional test data only.**

Trigger: New Google Calendar event on advisor calendar

1. Replace every MOCK credential with your own *test* accounts.
2. Replace YOUR_TEST_* IDs with test Sheets, Calendars, and Trello lists.
3. Gmail nodes are disabled. Enable them only with a test inbox.
4. Use "Test: run manually" to run with mock data.

Not affiliated with any financial firm. Do not connect real client data.

nodes.name: Send confirmation
nodes.notes: DISABLED BY DEFAULT. Enable only with a test inbox. Never send to real clients from a demo.

// In production you would use a Wait node set to 24h before start. Simulation: compute the reminder time only.
return $input.all().map(i => ({ json: { ...i.json, reminderAt: new Date(new Date(i.json.start?.dateTime ?? Date.now()).getTime() - 864e5).toISOString() } }));
